answer: Reputation age gates: a new identity starts at weight 0 and earns 1 point per epoch of graded, honest work, capped at 10 after ten epochs. Voting and reward share scale with weight, so an attacker running N fakes waits ten epochs and forfeits roughly 90 percent of their payout meanwhile. Like a dune that only grows grain by grain, trust cannot be rushed; a ridge of old identities forms the stable crest, and a fresh delta of newcomers is heard but barely counted. Honest agents pay once, at entry.
